dedupe_keys.name: phm society data repository and data challenges

description: The PHM Society Data Repository hosts the data of the society's yearly conference data challenges in prognostics and health management, together with a mirror of the NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence repository and further donated sets such as a servomotor-driven ballscrew degradation data set. Challenges run for the North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific conferences, with 2019, 2021 to 2025 and 2026 challenges listed. Each challenge page describes the task, data, scoring and results; for example, the 2022 challenge asked for fault classification of a rock drill from pressure sensor data, with 11 classes (ten failure modes and a healthy state) across individual drill configurations. Training data are released publicly, while validation labels stay blind until final scoring; the site offers sign-in and registration, which challenge submissions use. Coverage is international. No licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: each challenge has its own format, terms and documentation, and some test labels are withheld. For simulation it offers benchmark condition-monitoring and fault data for machines used in industrial, mining and energy systems. Related catalogue records include the NASA Prognostics Data Repository and the NIST SMS test bed data.
